t: Bred from a $(l:bees/solitary/nomad)Nomad Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/solitary/reed)Reed Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/solitary/nomad)游牧蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/solitary/reed)甘蔗蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/solitary/resin)Resin Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/worker/lumber)Lumber Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/solitary/resin)树脂蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/worker/lumber)木场蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/solitary/resin)Resin Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/worker_bees#lumber)Lumber Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/solitary/resin)树脂蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/worker_bees#lumber)木场蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。

Bred from a $(l:bees/wild/crystalline)Crystalline Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/wild/ender)Ender Bee$(/l).$(br2)The combs of this bee can be centrifuged to get certus quartz seeds which require further processing.
由一只$(l:bees/wild/crystalline)石英蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/ender)末影蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。$(br2)它的蜜脾可以离心得到赛特斯石英种子，还需要进一步加工。
Bred from a $(l:bees/wild/crystalline)Crystalline Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/draconic)Draconic Bee$(/l).$(br)Required mod: Quark
由一只$(l:bees/wild/crystalline)石英蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/draconic)末影龙蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。$(br)需要模组：Quark
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/coal)Coal Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/wild/magmatic)Magmatic Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/coal)煤炭蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/magmatic)熔岩蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/coal)Coal Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/hive/creeper)CreeBee(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/coal)煤炭蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hive/creeper)苦力怕蜜蜂(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hives#coal)Coal Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/wild/magmatic)Magmatic Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hives#coal)煤炭蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/magmatic)熔岩蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from a $(l:bees/hive/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) spawn egg using a Enchanting Apparatus.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋需要用附魔装置以一枚$(l:bees/hive/diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hives#coal)Coal Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/hives#explosive)Explosive Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hives#coal)煤炭蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hives#explosive)苦力怕蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from an $(l:bees/hive/iron)Iron Bee$(/l) spawn egg using an Infuser.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋需要用灌注器以一枚$(l:bees/hive/iron)铁蜜蜂$(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from a $(l:bees/solitary/nomad)Nomad Bee$(/l) spawn egg.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋由一枚$(l:bees/solitary/nomad)游牧蜜蜂$(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
This bee can be converted from a $(l:bees/wild/slimy)Slimy Bee$(/l) by feeding it some pink slime.
给一只$(l:bees/wild/slimy)史莱姆蜜蜂$(/l)喂食一些粉红史莱姆即可转化成它。
Bred from a $(l:bees/solitary/neon_cuckoo)Diamond Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/crystalline)Crystalline Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/solitary/neon_cuckoo)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/crystalline)石英蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from an $(l:bees/hive/iron)Iron Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/bees/hive/creeper)Creeper Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/iron)铁蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/bees/hive/creeper)苦力怕蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Obtained by giving salt to a vanilla bee
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/netherite)Netherite Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/hive/withered)Withered Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/netherite)远古蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hive/withered)凋灵蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hives#diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/hives#withered)Withered Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hives#diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hives#withered)凋灵蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/hive/withered)Withered Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hive/withered)凋灵蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/netherite)Netherite Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/draconic)Draconic Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/netherite)远古蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/draconic)末影龙蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hives#diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/draconic)Draconic Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hives#diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/draconic)末影龙蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from a $(l:bees/hive/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/draconic)Draconic Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/hive/diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/draconic)末影龙蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
Bred from an $(l:bees/mod_bees#allthemodium)Allthemodium Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/mod_bees#vibranium)Vibranium Bee$(/l).
由一只$(l:bees/mod_bees#allthemodium)ATM蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/mod_bees#vibranium)振金蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。
